At the same time, receiving performance of the 5G module was also tested. During the measurement, Balong 5000 can support downlink and uplink transmissions with about 330 and 44 Mb/s data rate, respectively, as shown in Fig. 14. When well connected to the 5G network, the whole delay from the sending request to the server to getting stable 8K video display is about 1.6 sec. These results prove that a 5G+DTMB-A UHDTV dual-mode receiver can support 8K UHDTV video service by effectively utilizing both wireless communication and broadcasting network. It makes full use of advantages from both systems, including broad bandwidth, easy access, good interactivity from 5G, wide coverage, low cost, and high reliability from broadcasting network. It provides a flexible and effective solution to 8K UHDTV industry.
